## Webscraping

```{r}
url <- "https://www.vlr.gg/event/stats/2282/?page=1&group=all&agent=all&map=all&timespan=all&min_rounds=0"

# Send GET request with headers
page <- httr::GET(url,
                  httr::add_headers(
                    `User-Agent` = "Mozilla/5.0",
                    Referer = "https://www.vlr.gg/event/stats/2282/valorant-masters-toronto-2025"
                  ))

html <- read_html(page)

# Get all table rows
rows <- html %>% html_elements("table.wf-table-in tbody tr")

# Extract row data
data <- lapply(rows, function(row) {
  cells <- row %>% html_elements("td")
  if (length(cells) < 11) return(NULL)  # skip incomplete rows

  player <- cells[1] %>%
    html_element(".text-of") %>%
    html_text(trim = TRUE)

  team <- cells[1] %>%
    html_element(".ge-text-light") %>%
    html_text(trim = TRUE)

  stat_vals <- sapply(cells[2:11], html_text, trim = TRUE)

  return(data.frame(
    player = player,
    team = team,
    rating = as.numeric(stat_vals[1]),
    acs = as.integer(stat_vals[2]),
    kills = as.integer(stat_vals[3]),
    deaths = as.integer(stat_vals[4]),
    assists = as.integer(stat_vals[5]),
    kd_diff = stat_vals[6],
    adr = as.numeric(stat_vals[7]),
    hs_percent = stat_vals[8],
    fk_fd = stat_vals[9],
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ))
})

# Combine into data frame
stats_df <- bind_rows(data)

# Save to CSV
write.csv(stats_df, "vlr_toronto_stats.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# Show preview
print(stats_df)
```
